title: SIDE STORY: LONE TRAIL OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: LONE TRAIL OPEN
DETAILS: Lone Trail event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, Case Investigation, and redeeming from Event Store.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES DURATION: Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
- Phase 1
DURATION: November 7, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - November 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Open Stages: The Coming of the Future
- Phase 2
DURATION: November 14, 2023, 16:00 (UTC-7) - November 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Open Stages: The Lingering of the Past
- Phase 3
DURATION: November 21, 2023, 16:00 (UTC-7) - November 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Open Stages: The Pursuing of the Present
Rhine Lab Pioneer Project
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain rewards by completing missions in [Case Investigation] and through Technological Transformation.
MAIN REWARDS: Technological Investigation Supply (provides random materials), Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
[Instruction Catalogue]
Event Instructions: During the event, players can complete [Instruction Catalogue] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
Reward: [★★★★★★: Silence the Paradigmatic], Rhine Tech Eco-Garden Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Flight Data Recorder Chip, etc.
[Special Case Contact, C.U.D.O.D.]
DURATION: November 7, 2023, 10:00 - December 5, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Flight Data Recorder Chip by clearing event stages and completing [Instruction Catalogue] missions. Flight Data Recorder Chip can be used to redeem items from [Special Case Contact, C.U.D.O.D.].
Reward: Silence the Paradigmatic's token, Rhine Tech Eco-Garden Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
◆Please stay tuned to us for more details.
- During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, this evnet will be included in the [Intermezzi].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – HERE I STAND

- Operator Muelsyse is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
- NOTE: Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.

11 PONY VALLEY MINING AREA PROVISIONAL MINING PERMIT
DURATION: November 7, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event period, players can conduct one mining operation per day in "Pony Valley Mining Area", and the types of ores that can be extracted from each mining operation include: Originium Crude Ore, Originium Ore, Originium Vein. The mined ore will be processed directly into Orundum
Originium Crude Ore is worth 400 Orundums, Originium Vein is worth 1000 Orundums, and Originium Ore's value varies
between Originium Crude Ore and Originium Vein, the exact value of which will be shown after it has been processed.
- You can only perform one mining operation per day, and the number of operations will be reset at 04:00 AM, and cannot be accumulated.

- If your daily mining operation fails to tap into an Originium Vein, your probability of tapping into an Originium Vein is increased the next time, and if you tap into an Originium Vein, the vein point will disappear.

- The mining operation was divided into three phases: [1st to 5th], [6th to 10th] and [11th to 14th]. If you have not mined an Originium Vein by the end of each phase, a Rhodes Island survey team will be guided to the Originium Vein on the last day of the phase, and you will receive 1,000 Orundum for mining it.
